typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RecipientId as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT RecipientId,ImportDate FROM dbo.NewYork_LTC_Primary where  (CategoryCode IN (\'15\',\'36\',\'42\',\'43\',\'48\',\'58\',\'59\') or  AidCategoryCode in (\'41\',\'42\',\'43\',\'70\',\'72\')) and ImportDate >= ? UNION SELECT RecipientId,ImportDate FROM dbo.NewYork_LTC_Secondary where  (CategoryCode IN (\'15\',\'36\',\'42\',\'43\',\'48\',\'58\',\'59\') or  AidCategoryCode in (\'41\',\'42\',\'43\',\'70\',\'72\')) and ImportDate >= ? UNION SELECT RecipientId,ImportDate FROM dbo.NewYork_MCD_Primary where  (CategoryCode IN (\'15\',\'36\',\'42\',\'43\',\'48\',\'58\',\'59\') or  AidCategoryCode in (\'41\',\'42\',\'43\',\'70\',\'72\')) and ImportDate >= ? UNION SELECT RecipientId,ImportDate FROM dbo.NewYork_MCD_Secondary where  (CategoryCode IN (\'15\',\'36\',\'42\',\'43\',\'48\',\'58\',\'59\') or  AidCategoryCode in (\'41\',\'42\',\'43\',\'70\',\'72\')) and ImportDate >= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(CodeType = 'NYENRL') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(CodeType = CodeType) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = RecipientId,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = CodeType,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE = ImportDate)) ~> PDSOBMEMBERCODESSTAGING1
